name: Lilo and Stitch RP 🌺🛸
desc:
🌺 Welcome to Lilo & Stitch RP 🛸
Like and favorite for future updates and game improvements! 🌊


Dive into the heart of Hawaii and explore the world of Lilo, Stitch, and their ohana! In this tropical roleplay game, you can:

🍍 Explore Lilo’s cozy home and vibrant island town
🌴 Discover secret experiments hiding across the island
🐬 Roleplay as Lilo, Stitch, Nani, Pleakley, Jumba, David, & more
🌊 Relax on the beach, or ride in a spaceship

Whether you're hanging with your alien best friend or dancing in a hula class, there's always something to do in this magical Hawaiian world. 🌴✨


Ohana means family... and family means no one gets left behind, or forgotten💙
